title: Arc: a ~70 MB streaming speech model that transcribes links names and metadata to your own list as they're spoken, with no second model [p]
summary: I built Arc-Transcriber, which does ASR-NL in 1-step. Every 100 ms, one model returns the transcript plus: - Names linked to a list you give it (a roster, contacts, product names); new names are flagged "not on the list" - Numbers with their values (scores, clocks, money, dates)
reason: Reddit self-post about a built model. R1 fails: link is a reddit.com thread, not an official owner announcement nor a full news article with observed named author/date. R5 fails: no repository/official announcement link. No paper, business, or policy event.
